purpose: More short and medium-length candidates with independently verified support for unused revision-27 vocabulary.
method: Each proposal is independently demonstrated with four revision-27 approved partners and at least one unused approved answer. Existing generator and level validation check connectivity, exact letters, no accidental runs, five answers, seven tiles, two long answers, landscape dimensions, density and phone cell size. No production dictionaries or policies changed.
limitations: Independent example boards may overlap in words and wheels. They do not by themselves establish extension capacity, joint 75-level spacing, chapter pacing or repetition. The owner approved 24 senses and left 26 unapproved. A separate full-sequence capacity experiment evaluates the combined 78 approvals; active revision 27 remains unchanged.
sourceAttribution: Individual dictionary links and hashes identify the Georgian explanatory dictionary by the Linguistic Technologies Group. Brief original English glosses only; full definitions are not republished.
